svg.title: KronSpice architecture
svg.desc: Package layout, main import paths, external energy channels and evaluation pipeline of kronspice, a pure-Go SPICE-compatible simulator used as the fitness engine for genetically evolved circuits. Boxes show packages that exist; planned work is listed in the footer. Checked against the code (go list imports and package sources). architecture.pdf is printed from this file.
svg.text: KronSpice architecture
A SPICE-compatible analog circuit simulator in pure Go, built as the fitness-evaluation engine for genetically evolved circuits

g.text: CLI: simulate a netlist → report / CSV
CLI: run a GA from a JSON config
kicad/ · report/ · internal/export — schematics, results sheets
kicad imports netlist · report imports analysis, kron, circuit, netlist
export writes the netlist, schematic and results sheet for each example
genome · encode_values (E-series) · encode_topology (parts grown into an embryo) · operators · fitness · checkpoint
Worker pool of runtime.NumCPU() · deterministic seeds · torn AC through kron · run directories, resume
Failed circuits (singular, no convergence, floating node, timeout) → penalty · weighted sum or NSGA-II
analysis/ — analyses on the MNA system
op · dc sweep · ac (complex128 per frequency) · tran (adaptive step, LTE, breakpoints)
newton: limiting · reltol 1e-3 · itl1 100 / itl4 10 → gmin, source stepping, pseudo-transient
measure: rise time, gain, −3 dB, overshoot, settling, crossings
power: IEEE 1459, geometric-algebra and quaternion (→ hyper) · energy ledger (→ em)
primitive Z / Y · connection C · Z′ = Cᵀ Z C
mesh & node forms, twin-tested vs. MNA (1e-9)
orthogonal · exterior open paths · TAN chords
diakoptics: tear, cache, re-solve only the mutant
dense LU, real and complex, partial pivoting: below 30 unknowns
sparse Gilbert–Peierls, minimum-degree ordering: 30 and above, or forced with Options.Backend
Imported by analysis, kron and evo. Newton iteration lives in analysis/
one Result type shared by MNA, kron and em
device/ — one file per device family, stamping through Stamper
R C L K · V I sources (DC PULSE SIN PWL EXP AC) · controlled E F G H · nonlinear B · gyrator Y · machine N · bearing · charge- and flux-defined C, L
Device: Setup · Load · LoadAC, with optional Reactive and Nonlinear — every device embeds device.Base, so it carries the full external port set
nodes, elements, models · builder.go: programmatic API used by evo
built from netlist/ or the Builder · Validate() before every simulation
gravity: Schwarzschild exterior, clock rates, signal redshift
optics: light delay and bending, effective medium n(r) for em/ field solvers
rotation: rotating frames and the fields a circuit sees
machine: one rotor under rotation and gravity
Keeps gravitational curvature apart from Kron's machine geometry
Leaf: imports nothing from the engine, callers wire its results in
em/ — Maxwell's equations in quaternion form
nabla (Hamilton ∇) · maxwell (Treatise form) · biquat ∇F = J · vcalc twin
extract: lumped R, L, C, K · tline · inductance · biotsavart · coil · dipole
limits: electrical size against the lumped model · dispersion · multipactor
energy: open-system ledger · efficiency, Tellegen balance
duality · podolsky: hypothetical physics, labeled as such
analysis/ uses the ledger; field code does not run inside Newton / LU
quat: Hamilton quaternions, products, rotors, matrices, exp / log
ga: Clifford algebra Cl(p,q,r), bitmask blades · G2, G3 + sparse multivector
Never imported by solver or device: inner loop stays float64 / complex128

svg.text: Result →
checks
lumped values (em) · media and loads (fluid) → wired into circuit.Builder by callers

g.text: exchange/ — external energy ports on every element (leaf, stdlib only · imported by device, circuit, output, em, analysis and kron)
Every element exposes one ExternalPort per registered channel. No model means exactly 0 W, listed as NotModeled. In Kron's terms each port is an open path to the exterior junction Ω of its channel.

svg.text: Evaluating one candidate
every evaluation runs under a context.Context deadline · AC can be solved torn, with pieces cached between candidates
any error → typed error → penalty fitness, so the GA learns from broken circuits
Open-system energy ledger
dW_stored/dt = P_in − P_out − P_dissipated
Kept per element × channel
Residual above tolerance ⇒ reported as an error
Model-supplied (E/F/G/H) and hypothetical power in their own columns
Efficiency (operating point and transient) · Tellegen's sum
Evolution cannot profit from energy appearing from nowhere
Twin check: Kron open-path ledger = MNA ledger, row by row
Design rules
Never panic or hang: typed errors, context deadlines
Deterministic: same netlist, options and seed, identical results
Parallel: no shared mutable state, passes the race detector
Electrical-size check for the lumped limit of Maxwell's equations
Solver core float64 / complex128, allocation-free solve
Golden tests vs. ngspice; twin tests for Kron, GA, quaternions
Pure Go, no cgo, no third-party dependencies

Not built yet (design in CLAUDE.md): env/ outside influences · plasma/ and arc models · bubble dynamics · FDTD and TLM field solvers · .subckt, .param, .include · switches · transmission-line devices · SPICE3 raw output · QSpice cross-check
